suite: World View V1 Field Package Parser and Writer Conformance Vectors
contract: ME-05-10 Field Package Parser / Writer Implementation Contract V0.1

cases.scenario: Open all three golden fixtures and validate structural index without decoding tile payloads.
Reject package shorter than the 72-byte fixed header.
Reject invalid magic, unsupported version, header length, flags or reserved bytes.
Reject declared package length unequal to physical file length.
Reject manifest offset other than 72 or zero/over-policy manifest length.
Reject nonzero alignment padding between manifest and directory.
Reject directory offset/length arithmetic overflow.
Reject directory version, flags, entry size or exact-length mismatch.
Reject tile count unequal to ceil(width/tile_width) multiplied by ceil(height/tile_height).
Reject directory count above configured resource policy.
Reject duplicate, missing, out-of-grid or out-of-order tile coordinates.
Reject edge tile valid_width or valid_height inconsistent with grid dimensions.
Reject tile decoded_length inconsistent with ordered manifest plane layout.
Reject duplicate codec IDs, missing codec 0 none or codec 0 with a non-none identity.
Reject unknown codec IDs and codec parameters not accepted by the registered implementation.
Reject misaligned, overlapping, out-of-range or unreferenced payload ranges.
Reject nonzero gaps/padding and trailing bytes after the final payload.
Read one requested tile without reading or decoding unrelated tile payloads.
Verify SHA-256 over canonical decoded planes before exposing the tile buffer.
Reject stored tile truncated before stored_length bytes are read.
Reject unsupported codec version without fallback decoding.
Reject decode output shorter or longer than decoded_length.
Reject encoded stream with trailing data when codec reports unconsumed input.
Reject decoded validity-mask values other than 0 or 1.
Reject coverage mask with invalid plane semantics or invalid values.
Reject tile hash mismatch and return no partially decoded tile.
Reject tile request outside the grid and never substitute a neighboring tile.
Reject allocation/decode request above configured decoded tile budget.
Repeated writes of identical manifest, tile bytes and pinned codec produce byte-identical packages.
Writer reproduces the three fixture packages byte-for-byte using fixture-only profiles.
Writer streams a field larger than the configured in-memory budget using bounded temporary spool storage.
Writer reopens the temporary package with the production reader and verifies every tile before handoff.
Reject duplicate, missing or out-of-grid tile inputs.
Reject non-deterministic or unpinned codec implementation/parameters for deterministic V1 output.
Cancellation removes or quarantines incomplete temporary output and never hands it to publication.
Disk-full or I/O failure leaves no publishable partial package.
Full package SHA-256 matches Core Asset metadata when streamed over exact final bytes.
Package hash mismatch is distinct from a tile hash mismatch.
Concurrent positional tile reads do not share or race a mutable stream position.
Dispose/cancellation prevents use-after-release of pooled decoded buffers.
Windows and macOS produce identical bytes and stable error codes for identical fixtures.
